title: 15 April 1964: Television: A Degree Of Frost
content:
Paul McCartney made his first television appearance without the other Beatles on 15 April 1964.

He was interviewed by David Frost for the BBC show A Degree Of Frost, in Studio 4 at BBC Television Centre in Wood Lane, London.

The interview was recorded before a studio audience from 8.30pm, although rehearsals had begun at 10.30am. A Degree Of Frost was a one-off chat and performance show, and was broadcast from 10.15pm on Wednesday 18 May 1964.
